items.prompt: Two new-sequence Add packets encode the same numeric 64-bit id with different uppercase/lowercase hex spellings. What happens to the second live Add?

options.text: ERR DUPID, preserving the first order.
options.why: Hex case does not change the decoded numeric identifier.

options.text: A second independent live order is created.
options.why: Identity is numeric, not the original hex text spelling.

options.text: The first order is overwritten with the second quantity.
options.why: A duplicate live Add is rejected without replacing its state.

options.text: A DUP sequence result solely because letter case differs.
options.why: The packets have new sequence positions; this is a business duplicate-ID condition.

items.explanation: Hex case does not change the decoded numeric identifier.
